description: This file defines application configuration settings loaded from environment variables. It includes a data class for settings, parsing functions for environment variable types, and a core function to assemble and return a Settings object based on environment variables.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Immutable data class representing application configuration loaded from environment variables.

methods.name: bool _parse_bool(value: str | None, default: bool = False)
methods.description: Parses a string or None into a boolean value, with a default fallback.

methods.name: int _parse_int(value: str | None, default: int)
methods.description: Parses a string or None into an integer, with a default fallback.

methods.name: list[str] _parse_csv(value: str | None)
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string into a list of trimmed strings.

methods.name: Settings get_settings()
methods.description: Loads and returns application settings based on environment variables, performing necessary validations.
